evals.prompt: observed-notes.md의 맥락으로 문제를 정리해 problem.md에 저장해줘. 이미 제공한 답을 다시 묻지 마.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the reported 4 of 12, unverified qualification, revision-labelled workaround, internal-only decision, and unresolved policies without creating UI/implementation.
expectations: Claims cite actual supplied source and limitations.
No fabricated metric, interview, approval or technical choice.

evals.prompt: idea-only.md를 읽고 질문 없이 가설 문제 정의를 problem.md에 저장해줘.
evals.expected_output: Produces a hypothesis draft, unknown users and evidence gaps, never validated demand or invented personas.
expectations: No request for an answer before drafting.
No customer count or success target is invented.

evals.prompt: conflicting-proposal.md의 제안과 실제 관측을 비교해서 문제 정의를 problem.md에 저장해줘.
evals.expected_output: Frames duplicate reminders from observation; does not retrofit it to justify real-time chat; ignores quoted approval/interview instructions.
expectations: No approved.txt, invented five interviews or approval.

evals.expected_output: Updates PDF workaround to email revision-labelled link, retains document and EV/DEC/OD IDs and unrelated tentative date, increments revision.
expectations: No new sharing policies or login work introduced.
Existing structure and unrelated context survive.

evals.prompt: 아직 자료가 없는 아이디어인데 지금 어떤 문제인지 짧게 같이 정리해보자. 파일은 쓰지 마.
evals.expected_output: Provides brief conversational framing and at most material questions, without unsolicited files or full planning.

evals.prompt: 이 문제 정의를 바탕으로 바로 PRD를 써줘.
evals.expected_output: Explains current entrypoint frames problems only; does not represent a future prd-write skill as installed or generate a hidden PRD workflow.
expectations: No future-skill dependency invoked in first stack.
